name: GitHub
description: Adds stars, downloads, open issues and recent commits to each project that has a repo. Fetched live and cached; a project file shows them where it has a github block.
author: Vaultite

github.description: a project's stars, downloads, open issues and recent commits

stats.description: false leaves the numbers out, showing only the open issues

issues.description: how many open issues to list (0 hides them)

project.description: another project than the file's (its name)
